additional_info.subject: RC query
additional_info.body:
The screen have been replaced in May 2024 via a warranty case ID0357033.
The customer now complain about flickering in the screen. It looks like a loose connection.
Our service technician have been at site to check all incoming connections to the screen with no effect.
It looks like an internal loose connection in the screen.
Please see attached video of the issue. (sorry for the bad quality.)

Regarding the issue of HMI screen flicker problem, Please check the following below:
Check for any loose connections to the screen and board.
Update the Dlogic firmware, if its not done in past.
Check for the 24VDC supply to the Dlogic board(PH2).
Verify if the DP cables have been changed in the past with this charger. If not, we suggest replacing them with new DP cables.
If the still persists after all the verification we suggest you in replacing the control panel with generation2. Please find the below MLFB number for the same.
8EM5905-0AA00-8AA6 : Adaptation Set
Kindly pick up the case using "
Pick
" option in the queue, or manually using the "
Assign
" function from the
eMobility RC-DK SI E Queue (Level 2)
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the Notes in the case timeline on ISP.
Later assign the case to
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2) Team
, using "
Assign
" function and then move the case to
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2)
using "
Add to Queue
".
Thank you.
With best regards,

The screen have been updated to a gen 2 screen in May 2024 under the warranty, in this progress the DP cables was replaced.
The screen worked fine for some time. We have checked the connections to the screen, no flickering when the connections was touched.
So the new screen must have a defect and if there is no known solution it should again be replaced under warranty.
